note: Quasi-elastic (QEL) νμ and ν̄μ charged-current cross section σ_qel(Eν) in bins of neutrino energy, flux-averaged per energy bin, NOMAD experiment (CERN SPS wide-band ν/ν̄ beam, mainly on Carbon target). Target: per neutron — two variants tabulated: (a) "Nucl" = per neutron bound in the NOMAD nuclear target (mainly Carbon), (b) "Free" = per free neutron, obtained by dividing the nuclear-target value by a Smith-Moniz-model correction factor g. No covariance is published (per-bin total uncertainty only).
